name: Conversation Poller
description: Polls GHL Conversations API for new replies. Filters by: contact has reactivation-live tag, contact lacks exit tags (booking-made, do-not-contact, not-interested, campaign-complete), AND the reply is threaded to a campaign outbound message (not a random inbound). Reads context, crafts brand-voice response, sends via Conversations API. Enforces all 12 guardrails.
